instruction: Use Microsoft Edge Immersive Reader to read the AP News article about preparing for a doctor appointment. Save `answer.txt` on the Desktop with five preparation details in webpage wording: the top tip for the start of the visit, the family-history requirement, what to check on medicine bottles, the nonprescription items not to forget, and the recent records to verify were received. Put one item per line in that order.
gt_steps: With the AP News appointment-preparation article active in Microsoft Edge, press `F9` to enter Immersive Reader.

Enter the following text:
`Bring a list of symptoms and questions
family medical history is critical
name and dose
vitamins and supplements
recent lab tests, hospitalizations or visits to other health providers`
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
